# Fixture provenance

`conversation.html` is a minimized actual DOM captured on 2026-10-29 after two anonymous Gemini browser generations in Chromium 156. Both synthetic marker prompts and their returned model answers are retained. Only user-query/model-response subtrees remain; session-related attributes and UI tracking data were removed, response IDs were replaced with response1/response2. Original DOM SHA-256: `abc99a9a17ece0fd01d9088a9e70438cb43135f34cf8bfeeb6096dedd8dac441`. This is executed answer evidence, not an HTTP bootstrap assumption.

`bootstrap.html` retains the actual public build from an anonymous HTTP 200 app response and replaces its session ID. Other config values are omitted. Original SHA-256: `818306a498da0e18bfc3f21d403c249351b2f8f07154d3d16ce4c6eec11c8044`. Neither fixture contains cookies, account credentials or browser anti-abuse tokens.
